title: Grade 8 Biology: Photosynthesis
subtitle: An inquiry lesson from leaf structure to energy conversion

slides.title: Start with a leaf question

slides.body: What changes when the same plant receives light or stays in the dark?

slides.title: The core process
slides.subtitle: Chloroplasts convert light energy
highlights: Light energy becomes stable chemical energy

milestones.label: Before
milestones.title: Destarch
milestones.body: Keep the plant in darkness to use existing starch.

milestones.label: Step 1
milestones.title: Cover
milestones.body: Cover part of one leaf as the control.

milestones.label: Step 2
milestones.title: Expose
milestones.body: Place the plant in light for several hours.

milestones.label: Step 3
milestones.title: Test
milestones.body: Compare the covered and exposed areas.

facts.label: low to high
facts.detail: The rate increases before another factor limits it.

facts.label: highest rate
facts.detail: The curve levels off when another factor becomes limiting.

slides.title: Evidence supports the conclusion
slides.subtitle: Compare the control and exposed areas

left.title: Exposed area
left.body: The indicator changes color, showing starch formation.

right.title: Covered area
right.body: The indicator stays unchanged, showing light is necessary.

slides.verdict: Only the light condition changed, so the evidence supports the role of light.
